decisions.title: Exact GitHub commit is executable authority
decisions.problem: Chat, PR prose and moving branches can become stale or ambiguous.
constraints: must be inspectable without paid infrastructure

decisions.title: Append-only events are authority; state files are projections
decisions.problem: Mutable STATE/HANDOFF files lose historical causality.

rejected.database-only event sourcing: adds availability and cost dependencies before measured need

mitigations: validator, unique IDs, exact commit hashes
decisions.reconsiderWhen: event volume or concurrent writers exceed repository semantics

decisions.title: One canonical authority writer per capability
decisions.problem: V1/V2 and compatibility paths can silently become competing sources of truth.
alternatives: selected authority facade + read-only shadow compatibility
decisions.selected: selected authority facade + read-only shadow compatibility
mitigations: export allowlist, startup owner assertion, negative compile fixtures

decisions.title: PR #46 is archive; PR #49 through #54 are the clean Phase 05 lineage
decisions.problem: The 26k-line exploratory PR is not human-reviewable and contains superseded implementations.
risks: same code duplicated across archive and clean chain
mitigations: exact SHA manifests and qualification-parent check
decisions.reconsiderWhen: clean chain fails to retain required capability

decisions.title: Authority score equals minimum of Build and Assurance
decisions.problem: Large code volume or written tests can be mistaken for proven maturity.
tradeoffs: scores remain low until evidence campaign
decisions.reconsiderWhen: formal assurance model replaces ordinal scoring

decisions.title: GitHub Actions manual-only and CD off during convergence
decisions.problem: Automatic CI/CD spends real money and can deploy unqualified code.
decisions.reconsiderWhen: measured value exceeds cost or self-hosted runner is justified

decisions.title: PR #55 is a control-plane overlay on exact PR #54 lineage
decisions.problem: V2 needs durable architecture/state without mutating unverified runtime code.

rejected.edit PR #54 directly: mixes runtime and control-plane review scopes

tradeoffs: PR #55 depends on stacked draft lineage
mitigations: exact base SHA and stale-by-default ContextPack

decisions.title: No package-root promotion before compatibility and evidence gates
decisions.problem: Deep authority candidates can bypass or break legacy callers when exported globally.

rejected.immediate root export: creates hidden authority and regression risk

mitigations: selected surface manifest and later import linter

decisions.title: Session, claim and handoff are first-class temporal nodes
decisions.problem: Agents can collide or disappear without durable ownership history.
evidence: session and claim records in control-plane/v2
mitigations: unknownExternalClaims flag and fail-closed overlap policy
decisions.reconsiderWhen: shared transactional claim service is justified

decisions.title: Canonical documents are compiled projections of machine-readable state
decisions.problem: Hand-edited documents contradict runtime and each other.
tradeoffs: generated sections must not be edited manually
mitigations: schema validation, source fingerprints, golden snapshots

decisions.title: No new distributed infrastructure without a measured trigger
decisions.problem: Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes or vector databases can add more failure modes than value.
evidence: current project scale and user constraint
decisions.reconsiderWhen: measured contention, event volume, latency or availability breaches documented threshold

decisions.title: PR #55 does not change runtime authority
decisions.problem: Architecture refactor work can accidentally broaden runtime blast radius.
alternatives: change runtime and control plane together

rejected.change runtime and control plane togethe: cannot separate architecture evidence from runtime behavior

tradeoffs: runtime fixes remain in clean Phase 05 chain
risks: root continuity edits may conflict later
mitigations: generated markers and merge conflict review
decisions.reconsiderWhen: V2 architecture is frozen and task explicitly targets runtime
